api:
<SankeyFunnel data={channels} stages={stages} name={|c: &Channel| c.name} value={|c: &Channel, i: usize| c.counts[i]} />
PropTypeDefault
dataone row per entry channelrequired
stagesVec<SharedString>: the funnel steps, in orderrequired
nameFn(&T) -> &str: the channelrequired
valueFn(&T, usize) -> f64: how many from this channel reached stage indexrequired
source_labeltext above the channel column"Source"
drop_labeltext before "after " on the drop-off nodes"Dropped"
dropsbool: show drop-off flowstrue
node_width, node_padding, link_opacity, tooltip, classas on <Sankey>

A funnel with several entries, built on the <Sankey> layout. Each channel's band keeps its colour through every stage, so you can see which channel converts. After each stage, the people who did not continue flow into a drop-off node placed right next to it. Counts above the previous stage are capped to it.

examples.title: Acquisition funnel
examples.description: Several entry channels flow through each stage; drop-offs peel off at every step. Hover a band.
examples.code:
#[component]
fn acquisition() {
    let data = use_signal(signup());
    rsx! { <SankeyFunnel data={data} stages={steps()} name={|c: &Channel| c.name} value={|c: &Channel, i: usize| c.counts[i]} class="h-96" /> }
}

examples.title: Checkout by device
examples.code:
#[component]
fn checkout() {
    let data = use_signal(channels(&[
        ("Desktop", &[9000., 4100., 2600., 2200.]),
        ("Mobile", &[14000., 4800., 2100., 1500.]),
        ("App", &[4000., 2600., 2000., 1850.]),
    ]));
    rsx! { <SankeyFunnel data={data} stages={stages(&["Cart", "Shipping", "Payment", "Order"])} name={|c: &Channel| c.name} value={|c: &Channel, i: usize| c.counts[i]} class="h-96" /> }
}
